log_file.description: Log file for the daemon's output (the Debian wrapper's `logfile` directive).

max_memory_mb.description: Memory for item storage, in megabytes (-m).

udp_port.description: UDP port to listen on; 0 disables UDP (-U).

bind_address.description: Interface(s) to listen on, comma-separated (-l). 0.0.0.0 exposes the cache without authentication.

max_item_size.description: Largest storable item with a k/m suffix (-I), e.g. 1m.

growth_factor.description: Slab chunk-size growth factor (-f); must be greater than 1.

no_evictions.description: Return an error instead of evicting items when memory is full (-M).

lock_memory.description: Lock all paged memory (-k); needs a raised memlock ulimit.

enable_sasl.description: Require SASL authentication (-S); memcached must be built with SASL.

extra_options.description: Further memcached options, one per line (e.g. '-b 2048').
